title: Chua Wee-Chern buys shares of Ho Bee Land Ltd
body: Chua Wee-Chern bought 220,000 shares of Ho Bee Land Ltd. This increases their holdings from 3,350,000 to 3,570,000 shares.

circumstances_desc: As announced by MLT on 12 August 2026, MLT has issued 17,976,013 new units payable to MLTM and 1,105,112  new units payable to Mapletree Property Management Pte. Ltd. ("MPM"). Both MLTM and MPM have nominated Mulberry Pte. Ltd. to receive the aggregate of 19,081,125 new units payable to them. Following the receipt of new units by Mulberry has resulted in the change in percentage level of its interest held by Mulberry.
title: Change in Mulberry Pte. Ltd's position in Mapletree Logistics Trust
body: Mulberry Pte. Ltd executed a transaction for 19,081,125 shares of Mapletree Logistics Trust. This increases their holdings from 916,670,369 to 935,751,494 shares.
